text.name: Article 5 Invoked
text.rules: Record "allies rally". LIO spends 1 point. Until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 more.
text.history: NATO invoked Article 5 of its founding treaty for the first time after the 11 September 2001 attacks, provisionally on 12 September and definitively on 2 October 2001.
